description: Calibrated mitochondrial-presequence discriminant: ADPRHL1 and orthologs against human transit-peptide and cytosolic reference sets
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score, StratifiedKFold

KD=dict(A=1.8,R=-4.5,N=-3.5,D=-3.5,C=2.5,Q=-3.5,E=-3.5,G=-0.4,H=-3.2,I=4.5,L=3.8,
        K=-3.9,M=1.9,F=2.8,P=-1.6,S=-0.8,T=-0.7,W=-0.9,Y=-1.3,V=4.2)
EIS=dict(A=0.62,R=-2.53,N=-0.78,D=-0.90,C=0.29,Q=-0.85,E=-0.74,G=0.48,H=-0.40,I=1.38,
         L=1.06,K=-1.50,M=0.64,F=1.19,P=0.12,S=-0.18,T=-0.05,W=0.81,Y=0.26,V=1.08)
def hmoment(s,delta=100.0):
    a=np.deg2rad(delta)*np.arange(len(s)); h=np.array([EIS.get(c,0) for c in s])
    return float(np.hypot((h*np.cos(a)).sum(),(h*np.sin(a)).sum())/max(len(s),1))
def feats(s,n=30):
    seg=s[:n]
    return dict(acidic=sum(c in 'DE' for c in seg), netQ=sum(c in 'KR' for c in seg)-sum(c in 'DE' for c in seg),
                meanKD=float(np.mean([KD.get(c,0) for c in seg])), hmom=hmoment(seg),
                RLS=sum(c in 'RLS' for c in seg)/len(seg))
def up(q,size=500):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":q,"size":size,"fields":"accession,sequence","format":"json"},timeout=55)
    r.raise_for_status(); return r.json()["results"]

pos=up("(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true) AND (ft_transit:*)",500)
neg=up("(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true) AND (go:0005829) NOT (ft_transit:*) NOT (ft_signal:*)",500)
P=pd.DataFrame([dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],**feats(e["sequence"]["value"])) for e in pos]); P['mito']=1
N=pd.DataFrame([dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],**feats(e["sequence"]["value"])) for e in neg]); N['mito']=0
N=N[~N.acc.isin(P.acc)]
ref=pd.concat([P,N],ignore_index=True)
print("Reference: %d human proteins with an annotated mitochondrial transit peptide, %d cytosolic controls"%(len(P),len(N)))

TRI={'ADPRHL1 (Q8NDY3)':'Q8NDY3','ARH1/ADPRH (P54922)':'P54922','ARH3/ADPRHL2 (Q9NX46)':'Q9NX46'}
T={k:requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{v}.fasta",timeout=40).text.split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","") for k,v in TRI.items()}
tri=pd.DataFrame({k:feats(v) for k,v in T.items()}).T
F=['acidic','netQ','meanKD','hmom','RLS']
print("\nQuery feature values:"); print(tri[F].round(3).to_string())
print("\nReference medians:"); print(ref.groupby('mito')[F].median().round(3).to_string())

X=ref[F].values; y=ref.mito.values
auc=cross_val_score(LogisticRegression(max_iter=4000),X,y,cv=StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=0),scoring='roc_auc')
clf=LogisticRegression(max_iter=4000).fit(X,y)
print("\nLogistic MTS discriminant on 5 N-terminal features: 5-fold CV ROC-AUC = %.3f (sd %.3f)"%(auc.mean(),auc.std()))
p_ref=clf.predict_proba(X)[:,1]
print("Reference score medians: transit-peptide %.3f | cytosolic %.3f"%(np.median(p_ref[y==1]),np.median(p_ref[y==0])))
pq=clf.predict_proba(tri[F].values)[:,1]
for k,p in zip(tri.index,pq):
    pct_m=100*(p_ref[y==1]<p).mean(); pct_c=100*(p_ref[y==0]<p).mean()
    print(f"  {k:22s} score={p:.3f}  -> {pct_m:.1f}th pct of transit-peptide set, {pct_c:.1f}th pct of cytosolic set")

# also score all canonical ADPRHL1 orthologs
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
    params={"query":"(gene:ADPRHL1) AND (taxonomy_id:7742) AND (length:[345 TO 375])","size":500,
            "fields":"accession,organism_name,sequence","format":"json"},timeout=90).json()["results"]
O=pd.DataFrame([dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],org=e["organism"]["scientificName"],**feats(e["sequence"]["value"])) for e in r])
O=O.drop_duplicates('org')
O['score']=clf.predict_proba(O[F].values)[:,1]
thr=np.quantile(p_ref[y==1],0.05)   # 95% sensitivity threshold on the transit-peptide set
print("\nCanonical-length ADPRHL1 orthologs scored: n=%d"%len(O))
print("  median score %.4f | max %.4f | threshold at 95%% sensitivity for true presequences = %.4f"%(O.score.median(),O.score.max(),thr))
print("  orthologs exceeding that threshold: %d/%d (%.1f%%)"%((O.score>thr).sum(),len(O),100*(O.score>thr).mean()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.4))
bins=np.linspace(0,1,40)
ax[0].hist(p_ref[y==1],bins=bins,alpha=.6,color='#C4553B',density=True,label=f'human mito transit peptide (n={int(y.sum())})')
ax[0].hist(p_ref[y==0],bins=bins,alpha=.6,color='#2F6DB5',density=True,label=f'human cytosolic (n={int((1-y).sum())})')
ax[0].axvline(pq[0],color='k',ls='--',lw=2,label='ADPRHL1 = %.3f'%pq[0])
ax[0].axvline(pq[2],color='#7B3F9E',lw=2,label='ARH3 = %.3f'%pq[2])
ax[0].set_xlabel('presequence discriminant score'); ax[0].set_ylabel('density')
ax[0].set_title('Calibrated N-terminal presequence score (CV ROC-AUC %.2f)'%auc.mean(),fontsize=10)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=7)
ax[1].hist(O.score,bins=np.linspace(0,0.3,40),color='#2E9E7E',edgecolor='w')
ax[1].axvline(thr,color='#C4553B',ls='--',lw=2,label='95%% sensitivity threshold = %.3f'%thr)
ax[1].axvline(pq[0],color='k',ls=':',lw=2,label='human ADPRHL1')
ax[1].set_xlabel('presequence discriminant score'); ax[1].set_ylabel('ADPRHL1 orthologs')
ax[1].set_title('%d canonical vertebrate ADPRHL1 orthologs,\nnone reaches the presequence threshold'%len(O),fontsize=10)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=7)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
O.to_csv('/agent/jobs/473cf4f5-f325-4c57-88f5-9278c2613938/provenance/adprhl1_ortholog_mts_scores.csv',index=False)
ref.to_csv('/agent/jobs/473cf4f5-f325-4c57-88f5-9278c2613938/provenance/mts_calibration_reference.csv',index=False)
